en: Black‑and‑white image showing a traditional felt-covered yurt mounted on a large two‑wheeled cart on an open grassy plain. A person stands to the left of the yurt, while another horse-drawn cart and several people appear in the middle distance. In the far background are low buildings and what look like temple or monastery structures on the horizon. There are some printed characters in an East Asian script along the bottom edge, suggesting a caption typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
